name: Mobile Mechanics
tagline: Skip the workshop queues. Verified mobile mechanics delivering transparent diagnostics and repairs to your location.
hook_headline: Professional car care, right in your driveway.
hook_body: Your vehicle is making an ominous sound, but taking a day off work to sit in a sterile dealership waiting room is impossible. Furthermore, you dread the inevitable, inflated bill. Bouul changes the paradigm. Browse vetted mobile mechanics, receive transparent upfront pricing, and have the workshop brought directly to your office or home.
pains: Losing a full day of productivity dropping off and collecting your vehicle.
The mechanic comes directly to your specified geolocation, allowing you to continue your day uninterrupted.
Opaque billing practices where the final invoice is double the verbal estimate.
All costs are quoted and approved digitally in advance, with funds held securely in escrow.
Anxiety regarding the competency of an unverified independent operator.
Bouul professionals possess verifiable track records, backed by reviews from localised, completed repairs.
audience: Families unable to manage without a vehicle for a day
Individuals purchasing second-hand cars requiring inspection
Drivers seeking dealership-quality work at independent prices
why_bodies: Repairs and servicing executed at your home or workplace, eliminating logistical headaches.
Diagnose the issue via chat and approve fixed-price quotes before a single spanner is turned.
Access specialists across vehicle brands, ensuring complex diagnostics are handled correctly.
trust: Escrow facility protecting against arbitrary overcharging
Live geolocation tracking for precise arrival management
faqs: Can complex diagnostics be performed remotely?
Yes, mobile mechanics arrive equipped with advanced OBD-II scanning tools capable of pinpointing complex electronic faults on-site.
How do I ensure the mechanic brings the correct parts?
You can upload a photo of your licence disc in the secure chat. This allows the professional to source the exact components for your specific model.
Does using a mobile mechanic void my warranty?
Under South African law, using an independent qualified mechanic for servicing does not automatically void manufacturer warranties, provided original specification parts are used.
